ELECTRICITY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Electricity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Electricity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Electricity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Electricity.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

3. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance.

4. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5 Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Ma.

7. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

8. When learning Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2., the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   B. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings 2.0 Electrical Machines 2.1 Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2..

9. When learning Electro- Magnetism, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electro- Magnetism.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Electro- Magnetism.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electro- Magnetism.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electro- Magnetism.

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

11. When learning Pictorial Drawings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pictorial Drawings.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pictorial Drawings.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pictorial Drawings.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pictorial Drawings.

12. When learning Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Magnetism 2.2 Electromagnetism 2.3 Inductors and Inductance 3.0 Electrical Insta.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Semiconductor Theory 4.2 Semiconductor Diodes 4.3 Transistors Page 15 of 52 1 ST and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Semiconductor Theory and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Semi- conductor Diodes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors Page 15 of 52 1 STRAND 1.0 FUNDAMENTALS OF ELECTRICITY Strand Sub St and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
